title: Dog House
description: The Signature dog house is an original Signature design: it is 34 by 24 inches with a Signature front porch overhang that shades the door and a removable Signature roof panel for cleaning. This is a Signature original, not a public plan.

image.description: Dimensioned sketch of Dog House: overall 34 x 28 x 24 in in, showing the plan/elevation outline with dimension labels and key features of the design.
image.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="240" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><rect x="50" y="60" width="120" height="60" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/><polygon points="50,60 110,30 170,60" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="50" y1="132" x2="170" y2="132" stroke="#333"/><text x="50" y="148" font-size="11">34.0 in wide</text><text x="50" y="52" font-size="11">Dog House</text></svg>

specs.tolerances: Panels square within 1/8 in; door opening within 1/2 in of dog shoulder width plus 2 in.
specs.load_notes: General guidance only: check local permits, setbacks, and building codes before building, and consult a licensed professional for any permitted structure. Snow and wind loads vary by region; the notes below state general guidance, not a code calculation. Roof snow load: light, general guidance only; clear heavy snow from the roof and keep the house out of snow-drift zones.
specs.arithmetic_note: Cut list totals: 6 pieces, total linear length 188 in, total board feet 17.61. Overall dimensions 34 x 28 x 24 in in are consistent with the primary pieces: the longest piece does not exceed the longest overall dimension, and every piece dimension is positive with qty of at least 1.

steps: Measure the dog's standing height and shoulder width.
Cut wall, side, floor, and roof panels.
Build the floor on skids 4 inches off the ground.
Assemble walls, fit the door opening, and add the sloped roof.
Seal edges, add dry bedding, and check the house stays dry in rain.

tools.safety_notes: Wear eye and hearing protection whenever power tools run; keep blades guarded; never work on a roof or platform without fall protection and a second person nearby; check for buried utilities before digging post holes.

demo.code:
# Cut-list board-foot calculator (board feet = L x W x T / 144, per piece x qty)
CUTS = [('wall panel', 34, 24, 0.5, 2), ('side panel', 24, 24, 0.5, 2), ('floor', 34, 24, 0.75, 1), ('roof panel', 38, 28, 0.5, 1)]
total_bf = 0.0
for piece, length, width, thick, qty in CUTS:
    bf = length * width * thick / 144.0 * qty
    total_bf += bf
    print("%s: %.2f board feet" % (piece, bf))
print("Overall dimensions: 34 x 28 x 24 in in")
print("Total board feet: %.2f" % total_bf)
print("Pieces: %d" % sum(q for _, _, _, _, q in CUTS))

side panel: 4.00 board feet
floor: 4.25 board feet
